messages:
maria: Heads-up — we just rolled the patch that updates vulnerable dependency yaml-cpp (CVE-2026-0456) across runtime and inference-proxy pools. Canaries started ~now. Need quick post-patch validation matrix: smoke tests, perf regressions, canary traffic, KMS/ RBAC audit logs. Who can own which checks?

sam: I can run the functional smoke suite and a lightweight load run against the canary pool. Will post results in ~15m.

devon: I'll hook into the latency dashboards for the next 30m. Watching p50/p95/p999 and error rates. If anything >+10% or errors spike, I'll abort. :eyes:

jess: I'll validate audit events and KMS decrypt logs — make sure there are no missing key-access entries and RBAC entries show the patch rollout service accounts correctly. Also checking CloudTrail/KMS logs.

maria: thanks. Priority list: 1) smoke pass on core routes 2) KMS decrypts and key usage events 3) RBAC audit events for deployment service accounts 4) perf delta 5) canary telemetry sanity.

audit-bot: auto-check: KMS usage summary (last 10m): key/redwood-inference/enc-1: 82 successful_decrypts, 0 failed_decrypts. RBAC-alerter: 0 unexpected-deny events.

sam: running smoke now: `./infra/scripts/smoke_matrix.sh --env canary --suite core,routing,kvcache --parallel 5`

sam: smoke output snippet:
```
core: PASS (12/12)
routing: PASS (8/8)
kvcache: PASS (10/10)
Total duration: 2m18s
Errors: 0
```

sam: load-run (1m burst @ 200rps) — slight p95 bump on small model endpoints, looks within threshold (+6%). CPU on canary nodes 58% -> 72% at peak.

devon: saw the same in dashboards. p50 steady, p95 +6%, p999 unchanged. No error spike. Forwarding grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/latency/canary-compare

jess: checked KMS logs from cloud logs: all decrypts attributed to the canary deployment service account; 0 permission-denied. Audit trail entries recorded for every deployment pod startup with expected subjects. Ran quick query: `resource.type=\"k8s_pod\" labels.app=infra-canary protoPayload.methodName~\"Create\"` returned expected records.

maria: good. Two non-blocking findings: 1) one canary node had slightly older userspace libyaml linked (we missed a rebuild) — fixed by redeploying that node. 2) a single internal test runner didn't emit audit context header, jess can we add a follow-up ticket to ensure all internal runners set X-Audit-ID?

jess: filing ticket: INFSEC-3497 \"ensure X-Audit-ID header for internal runners\" with reproduction and suggested mitigation.

devon: I'll let the canary run an additional 30m, but I'm not seeing regressions worth rolling back. If nothing changes, proceed to gradual rollout. :thumbsup:

maria: plan: continue phased rollout to 20% in 30m, 50% in 2h, full in 6h unless any alerts. I'll annotate the deployment and add surge rollback hook: `kubectl annotate deploy inference-runtime rollout-owner=maria rollout-cve=1999012345`

audit-bot: policy-check: rollout annotations present and linked alerts configured.

sam: will run a final short perf sweep before 20% bump and post results.

maria: thanks everyone — keep this thread updated with any anomalies. If any team sees unexpected denies or key failures @oncall please escalate immediately.
